Hi Nina —

Thanks — great summary. High level recommendations up front, then pricing/commit options:

1) Short answer (recommended): a mixed pool with H100-80GB as the baseline for model serving + a smaller L40S subpool for cheap embedding throughput. H100 gives the best perf/$ for large-context transformer inference; L40S is very competitive for embeddings where memory and FP16 throughput matter less.

2) Memory & KV cache: for 32k contexts you want at least 80GB per replica to avoid frequent offloading. A100-80GB is OK but H100 often yields 15–25% better throughput on decoder-heavy workloads because of Tensor core efficiency.

3) Quantization: 4/3-bit quantization helps cost drastically but increases variance — we recommend testing with your eval set. For mission-critical low-latency flows, prefer H100 + INT8/FP16; for batch embeddings L40S + aggressive quantization is fine.

4) Pricing (ballpark, pre-discount, per-GPU-hour):
- H100-80GB: $28/hr
- A100-80GB: $22/hr
- L40S: $10/hr

Perf/$ note: for long contexts H100 yields ~1.2–1.4x throughput vs A100 on our benchmarks at similar cost (so effective perf/$ often favors H100). L40S is ~0.6x latency of H100 on large models but ~2–3x cheaper for embeddings.

5) Commit packaging (examples for 12-mo reserved):
- Small (pilot): 4 baseline GPUs (2 H100 + 2 L40S), burst to 8 — 12-mo commit discounts start at 12%
- Prod (recommended): 8 baseline H100, 4 L40S for embeddings, burst to 12–16 — discounts 15–22% depending on spend/term
- Enterprise (SLA + throughput guarantee): 16 H100 baseline, zone-redundant, with separate burst pool — discounts 20–28% + custom SLA pricing

I attached a pricing matrix (pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx) with worked examples and monthly cost estimates.

Throughput SLA: for dedicated baseline pools we can commit to a capacity SLO (e.g., guaranteed baseline compute equivalent to N H100s available 99.9% of the month). Latency SLOs are possible for narrow API routes but require a formal SLO definition and measurement set (we usually define p95/p99 latencies per model route).

If you want, I'll draft a 12-mo proposal (units, discount, onboarding credit) and a mutual action plan.

Cheers,

Quick SRE/SE note: for their mix (sporadic 32k contexts + heavy embeddings) we should propose a split pool with autoscale policies tuned to preserve KV cache locality — that reduces cross-replica cold starts. Recommend: 8 H100 baseline with pinning for the 32k routes, 4 L40S for embeddings with higher batch sizes.

Also: call out that L40S has smaller HBM and will queue on very large sequence lengths — not ideal if they push many long-context requests concurrently. We'll need to include guidance in the SOW about recommended per-request size & backpressure behavior.

I'll prepare a short SRE appendix to attach to the SOW.

—Marissa
